questions.question:
Select the correct option that will fill in the blank and complete the series.

MIXTURE, IXTURE, IXTUR, _____, XTU
questions.solution:
In each step one letter from the word MIXTURE is been removed. In first step first letter of the word at the start of the series is removed. In second step last letter is removed.

MIXTURE = first word of the series

IXTURE = First letter of the first word of the series is excluded = second word of the series

IXTUR = Last letter of the second word of the series is excluded = third word of the series

**XTUR = **First letter of the third word of the series is excluded = fourth word of series

XTU = Last letter of the fourth word of the series is excluded = fifth word of the series

Hence, the correct answer is XTUR.

questions.question: Among 5 boys in a class, P is taller than M; M is taller than N, S is taller than M, R is taller than S. Which one of the following statements can definitely be concluded from the above information?

options.text: R is the tallest among the given boys.
N is the shortest among the given boys.

questions.solution:
We rewrite the conditions using inequalities,

1. P > M

2. M > N

3. S > M

4. R > S

So, we get,

P > M > N; R > S > M

1) S is taller than P → possible but not definite.

2) R is the tallest among the given boys → possible but not definite.

3) P is taller than R → possible but not definite.

4) N is the shortest among the given boys → **definitely true.**

Hence, correct answer is option 4.
